svg.text: One simulation cell, one p3 cell, one fundamental domain
g227 · orbifold 333 · clockwork symbol r33₁3₂ · triangular mesh, N = 36 (1296 nodes per channel)
one simulation cell = nine fundamental domains
the fundamental domain, and what each edge reads
the drawn cell — what the solver integrates
one p3 cell — three domains, one centre of each class
one fundamental domain — 146 of the 1296 nodes
edge glued with no delay (the turn about the τ = 0 centre)
edge reads the domain as it was T/3 ago
edge reads it as it was 2T/3 ago
The neighbour across a glued edge is the representative’s own past. Gluing with a lag turns the reaction–diffusion equation on the domain into a delay equation
whose only extra parameter is T; the three cone points are the three rotation-centre classes, carrying τ = 0, 1/3 and 2/3.
